#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check if addon.py and bundled/addon.py are identical. Report first difference."""
import sys

root_path = "addon.py"
bundled_path = "src/blender_mcp/bundled/addon.py"

with open(root_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    root_text = f.read()
with open(bundled_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    bundled_text = f.read()

if root_text == bundled_text:
    print("IDENTICAL - no differences")
    sys.exit(0)

print(f"root has {len(root_text)} chars, bundled has {len(bundled_text)} chars")
# Find offset of first difference
min_len = min(len(root_text), len(bundled_text))
diff_start = None
for i in range(min_len):
    if root_text[i] != bundled_text[i]:
        diff_start = i
        break

if diff_start is not None:
    ctx_size = 80
    print(f"First difference at char offset {diff_start}")
    # Show context from both files around the discrepancy
    r_ctx = max(0, diff_start - ctx_size)
    b_ctx = max(0, min(len(bundled_text), diff_start + ctx_size))
    print(f"ROOT CONTEXT:       ...{root_text[max(0,diff_start-40):diff_start+40]}...")
    
    if len(root_text) >= diff_start and len(bundled_text) >= diff_start:
        # Find the end of the differing segment for each
        r_end = diff_start
        b_end = diff_start
        while root_text[r_end:r_end+max(1,r_end-min_len)] == bundled_text[b_end:min(len(bundled_text),b_end+max(1,b_end-min_len))] and r_end + 40 < len(root_text) and r_end > 0:
            r_end += 2
            
        # Try to print something useful
        pass
    
    # Just show the diff lines around first change
    r_lines = root_text.split('\n')
    b_lines = bundled_text.split('\n')
    line_num = 0
    char_offset = 0
    for li, line in enumerate(r_lines):
        if char_offset + len(line) >= min(diff_start, min_len):
            print(f"\nROOT lines {li}:")
            for j in range(max(0, li-2), min(len(r_lines), li+3)):
                marker = "  >>" if j == li else "    "
                print(f"{marker} {j+1}: {r_lines[j]}")
            break
        char_offset += len(line) + 1
    
    print(f"\nBUNDLED lines:")
    for j in range(max(0, li-2), min(len(b_lines), li+3)):
        marker = "  >>" if j == li else "    "
        print(f"{marker} {j+1}: {b_lines[j]}")

else:
    if len(root_text) < len(bundled_text):
        extra_start = min(len(bundled_text), len(root_text))
        print(f"BUNDLED has extra at offset {extra_start}: ...{bundled_text[extra_start-40:extra_start+40]}...")
    else:
        extra_start = min_len
        print(f"ROOT has extra at offset {extra_start}: ...{root_text[extra_start-40:extra_start+40]}...")

sys.exit(1)
